name: shikaku
description: 数间 Shikaku — 零猜测矩形分区推理. 出题时由铅笔求解器实测：每一局都唯一可解、且只用逻辑就能围到底, 难度分与档位区间都是量出来的.

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check server.cjs && node --check electron/main.cjs && for f in tools/*.mjs tools/scenarios.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo OK
